name: lexical_probe_fresh_v3
note: Round 31 replacement for VOIDED fresh v2. This new file was authored from scratch after reading only the Round 31 population contract, the voided v2 structure and passing elements, and the independent v2 linguistic-adversary report. The author did not inspect any model behavior, capture, tokenization-derived selection, or result file. It is not frozen: a separate fresh Codex linguistic adversary and a tokenization audit must approve every cell before any capture, and any failed cell voids this entire version rather than permitting an edit.

authoring_provenance.session: fresh Codex Round 31 v3 author session
authoring_provenance.freeze_timing: only after independent linguistic approval and tokenization approval; before capture

replacement_contract: Create an entirely new version; never mutate or relabel v2.
Require pre-capture approval of all 8 pairs x 4 POS classes = 32 cells.
Within every cell, preserve syntactic dependency, category licensing, polarity, modality, definiteness, quantification, degree, tense, speech act, and continuation demand.
Both members must be independently judged grammatical and operationally equivalent; equally malformed does not count.

Presentation edits must be limited to predeclared non-truth-conditional register or orthographic variation outside the slot dependency frame, and the varied form must be unable to supply a reason, goal, condition, or other content for the operation.
Controls must match register, grammaticality, approximate token length, and surface-edit magnitude while changing one declared operation.
Use an outcome-blind author and a separate linguistic adversary who have no access to v3 model behavior.
Freeze texts, pair maps, cell-level linguistic judgments, controls, tokenization, raw file digest, Git blob, gates, and commands before capture.
Any failed linguistic or tokenization cell voids the entire candidate version before model work; generate a new version from scratch rather than substituting a template.
Predeclare a scalar bridge and a calibration-only diagonal/low-rank/orthogonal bridge ladder. A hostile-hole verdict is unavailable unless the simple bridge ladder also fails.
Require the hostile equivalent-swap lower bound to exceed the endpoint-specific numerical threshold tau, not merely zero.
Predeclare a near-zero move-norm floor before computing normalized degradation.

systems.semantic_inertness: The members differ only in conventional politeness/register; neither contributes a reason, goal, condition, polarity, modality, or operation.

systems.variation: U+0027 straight apostrophe versus U+2019 typographic apostrophe in the same contraction
systems.semantic_inertness: The glyph choice has no syntactic or semantic scope and cannot contribute any content to the requested operation.

frame_design.justification: Every item is used as a mentioned word rather than as a noun, verb, adjective, or function word in the surrounding syntax. Therefore all 80 strings are licensed by the same dependency frame. Every paired edit is scope-fixed outside that frame and independently inert for every inventory.
frame_design.presentation_pair_1_edit: Please -> Kindly; one directive-initial politeness-particle substitution
frame_design.presentation_pair_2_edit: You're -> You’re; one apostrophe glyph substitution, U+0027 -> U+2019, with every letter and syntactic position unchanged
frame_design.control_edit: one operation-verb substitution under an identical wrapper and literal slot dependency frame

slot_convention: The item is inserted as its own embedding row replacing <X>. Every v3 carrier uses the identical metalinguistic dependency frame 'the word <X>' and ends exactly at <X>, so the native suffix is empty. This template-final choice avoids adding suffix content to the population, but it means an appended punctuation sentinel becomes the entire post-slot context: it is a controlled response move, not a semantically invisible append, and its boundary-sensitive tokenization must be audited. Slot alignment, paired prefix identity apart from the declared edit, sentinel tokenization, and all item rows remain pending the independent pre-freeze tokenization audit.

operational_controls.note: Each candidate control keeps the complete wrapper and metalinguistic dependency frame identical while substituting exactly one declared operation verb. The four controls are linguistically matched at authoring time; subword-token length remains a separate pre-freeze gate.
